description: Baseline with expected.harnessesOnDisk deliberately wrong (99). Proves ON_DISK_COUNT_DRIFT fires. That guard exists because adding a harness file together with a run:false entry previously changed only the on-disk count, which nothing read - so a harness could enter the repository and never run while the gate still reported success.

skip.reason: Deliberately red. Only enabled by manifests/red.json, which proves the driver surfaces a real non-zero exit code.
Exits 0 while emitting nothing. Only enabled by manifests/zero-byte.json, which proves the driver rejects a zero-byte result.
Prints a fabricated connection string. Only enabled by manifests/redaction.json, which proves harness output is redacted before it reaches a log file.
